definitions: Go or come after (a person or thing) so as to be behind or on the heels of them.
Act according to or comply with (an instruction, rule, or principle).
Understand (the meaning or argument of someone or something).
Take (something) as a guide or model.
Be a logical consequence or result of (something).
Become a follower or supporter of (a person, team, or activity).
examples: The dog followed its owner everywhere.
I couldn't follow the plot of the film.
She followed her dream of becoming a doctor.
A period of economic growth followed the recession.
It follows that he must be guilty.
He followed a career in law.
She follows her favourite football team.
